text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of bachelor degree Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of bachelor degree 5. Bank Statement (No less than 20000RMB) 6. Non-criminal certificate 7. Physical examination form 8. Two recommendation letters 9. Personal Statement 10. English certificate (Duolingo test, IELTS, TOEFL)
